definition: The floor of the tone scale: how close the darkest values sit to true black.

not_the_same_as.vec_shadow_density: Shadow density is how heavy the shadow masses feel, not only the black floor.

open_questions: Can black lift be isolated from haze and veiling glare?

prompt_phrases.low: true dense black floor, no lift

scoring_guidance: 0 = true black floor, 1 = strongly lifted blacks.
testable_claim: Raising black level lifts the floor without necessarily opening mid-shadows the same way.
